top_jobs.description:
At Greenventory, we build a data-driven web-GIS platform that helps organizations understand and act on energy and infrastructure data, so cities and companies can actually move toward climate neutrality.

We work out of a modern office in Freiburg, with the flexibility to also work from home. We're a fast-moving, international development team, and we're looking for a Software Engineer to take ownership of frontend work and help shape how we build our product.
